narr: Low pressure moved very slowly east from the eastern Pacific across the Mojave Desert, triggering scattered thunderstorms for a few days. Several storms produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: California Highway Patrol reports flash flooding on Nipton Road.
Highway 95 was flooded with water and mud at mile marker 70.
Morning Star Mine Road was flooded and impassable.
Water and mud flowed across Highway 62 near mile marker 56. Multiple vehicles were stuck.
Kelso Road was closed south of Kelso due to damage from water, mud, and debris.
Flash flooding damaged a water main in Yucca Valley, knocking out water service to part of the town.
Highway 247 was flooded and impassable at Buena Suerte Road due to flooding and debris.
Highway 62 was flooded at Church Street.
Yucca Mesa Road was flooded with water and debris.
